runtime: fastembed 0.8.0 TextCrossEncoder, ONNX CPU, control venv, default threads

definitions.D0: identity control through the window machinery
definitions.D1: cross-encoder over (question, session_text[:2000]); session score = model score; sort window desc, shipped order breaks ties
definitions.D2: V1 term coverage over session text; sort window desc, shipped order breaks ties
definitions.D3: RRF k=60 of shipped rank and D1 rank within the window
definitions.window: first W distinct sessions of the shipped order; positions W+1 and below unchanged

gate_rule: >=5.0 points pooled recall@1 AND p<0.05 AND anchor loss <0.5 points
